k1.reasoning: The pre-registered K1 test fired in the repaired round on both decisive sub-tests, and the firing is structural, not a bug (two independent from-scratch re-runs reproduce the pilot bit-for-bit; hand-checked C1/C2/C3/C4 code lengths match). K1-machine: in C1 the Shapley value of EC (energy conservation) is 3755 (D0) -> 788 (D1) -> 345 (D2) -> 220 (D2M) bits while UG stays ~518-696, so the top law flips EC->UG at D2 in every primary code (C1/C2/C4; DIST is top in C3). K1-primary: top law is EC in C1/C3/C4 but UG in C2 (503.9 vs 573.4; margin only 12 bits, LOSO shows dropping any of P09/P10/P11 cancels it, so this sub-test alone is fragile). What makes the kill robust is the extended evidence: the pilot's own extra codes (C7 symbolic-regression tokens: top UG) and the verifier's four independent codes at D1 (TBX textbook-entropy: EC 740 > UG 458; EQW Eureqa weights: UG 763 > DIST 458 > EC 386; NCT node count: UG 553 > EC 536; C2F refitted C2: UG 825 > EC 623) give top-law flips in every case; over all 8 codes min Spearman rho = 0.65 (criteria (a) and (b) both fire), bootstrap P(fire) 0.68-0.80. With the differentiation decoder charged (at least as reasonable at D1, where the base machine has no differentiation) the top law is UG in 5 of 9 codes and EC falls to 34 bits under EQW; at D2 charged EC is negative. Constant precision moves N2 from last to 3rd (Phi -140 -> +459 from B4 to B64, linear in B). Per-system-normalised Phi makes N2 or DIST the top law (min rho 0.117). The reason is quantitative: the Kolmogorov-invariance constants (decoder 357-1248 bits, statement CSE 100-300 bits, machine primitives 100s-1000s of bits) are the same order as the gaps between laws (~100-400 bits) on any textbook-sized corpus, and the corpus weighting (P11's 10 gravity pairs, G04's triple pendulum) decides the top law. Stable features exist (LC last, EC/UG in the top 3 in most D1 codes, rho >= 0.85 within the C1-derived family), but the thesis needs a ranking of laws by value, and the headline ordering is set by the code, the machine, and the corpus, with an abbreviation control (DIST) reaching top-2 under EQW and top-1 in C3 at D2. K1's condition holds by design.

k2.reasoning: Under the frozen literal rule K2 did NOT fire (K2-deg-R fired; K2-deg-G did not; K2-collapse INDETERMINATE / operative 'not fired' because EC kept a constraint label). That literal outcome rests on two design defects and does not rescue the candidate. (1) Restriction semantics (Track R, the only reading carrying claim (ii)) is degenerate by identity: I verified from trackR.json that I_R1(b=8)/codim = 9.3257 = b + 1/2 log2(2 pi) in all 18 cells, so V^R = 9.33*sum(codim) - L(f) exactly; R^2 vs codim is 1.000/0.997/0.981/0.999 in R1-R4. The corpus never enters (I is independent of M_k), so claim (i) is empty there, and 75% of EC's Track R value (966 -> 192 bits) is the designer's 'no damping' C=0 slots. Claim (ii) is codim x bits-per-dimension, i.e. Popper/Rissanen/Tahmasebi-Jegelka dimension counting. (2) Track G: per-cell phi is not a trivial count (spec M1 CV-R^2 <= 0; best per-law-slope count models 0.70-0.78), but the residual is corpus composition (the top two systems carry 76-89% of EC/UG/HK/N3 Phi) and representation convenience: per-system values are negative in many cells (N2 on P07/P10/P11, N3 on P06, EC = -1 bit on every family-P system), which is impossible for semantic information and is the signature of abbreviation. (3) EC, the only measured 'constraint-type' law, is count-degenerate under any a-priori family-aware model: the spec's additive-linear 7.3 regression (CV-R^2 ~ 0) cannot represent the observed shape, whereas famP + famG*n^3 (Christoffel-term count) or famP + famG*r_fk*n gives LOSO CV-R^2 0.92-0.995 in all four codes; every family-P point is exactly -1 bit and family-G points are -0.6, 44-113, 419, 954 for n=1..4. Under that model EC is removed, the operative K2-collapse fires and, with K2-deg-R, K2 fires overall. Caveat: only four distinct n values, but the fit is near-exact. (4) Collapse is demonstrated by explicit macro rewrites: PC's saving equals the base output-referencing item cost to 0.0 bits wherever that form is chosen (a variadic macro); EC at D2M is a repeated 64-70-bit Map item, and with one 1-hole ELmap template its family-G leftover is ~35 bits < L(EC) = 68.8 < tau = 56; EC's V_loo = -1.0 on every particle system once the force templates are present; without family G, whose ground truth is literally EL(T-V) from the same (T,V) EC writes down, EC is no-value in all four codes at the primary setting (C1 -174/-82, C2 -392/-375, C3 -665/-406, C4 -136/-60). Every generic mechanism granted to the baseline (factoring, s*V, CSE'd statements, linear solve, differentiation, map) lowered every law's value monotonically (LC 301 -> -111, N3 75 -> -18, N2 503 -> 260, EC 3755 -> 220), so 'constraint' is a property of what the reference machine lacks (K1 territory), not of the law. (5) The classifier cannot be validated: POS can save at most 38-30 = 8 bits against tau_C4 = 56 (unpassable by construction), and both miners fail the negative control (DIST, a literal macro, recovered only 34-78%; V+ > V for EC). (6) H1 is confirmed for the motivating example: F=ma has codim 0 per system, its Track R content is the Mach block 9.33 bits = (B-1)(S-1)*b, its Track G value is per-body /m_i factoring (~10-12 bits per body, negative for mass-proportional forces) and its C4 value is linear in precision. Hypothesis (iii) is refuted under fair baselines (LC no-value; DIST outranks it in kappa). Net: in both semantics V_c is either a count or a machine-relative macro residual; there is no real distinction to measure.

k3.reasoning: Killed on the second clause (the conceptual distinction is standard, so only an incremental contribution remains); the first clause is not met, since none of the three independent sweeps (75+ searches, 2018-2026) nor my spot-checks found anyone ranking named physical laws by corpus-level description-length savings. The concepts are all prior: abbreviation-vs-constraint is Lewis's notational simplicity (the F-predicate trivialization, i.e. exactly the macro problem) vs BSA strength, with Woodward 2014's language-dependence objection anticipating K1; Kitcher's 'few patterns' vs 'stringency'; claim (ii) is Bar-Hillel-Carnap/Hintikka content and Popper's empirical content and dimension (and as stated it is wrong: the quantity is -log pi(H_f), equal to log(#excluded) only under a uniform prior); the quantitative form of constraint value is Rissanen/Grunwald's (k/2) log n + log Fisher-volume and Tahmasebi-Jegelka/Elesedy-Zaidi dimension-plus-log-quotient-volume, which is precisely the Track R identity the pilot found; corpus-level 'pay L(f) once' is Baxter/multi-task MDL amortisation (H1's reuse collapse); the Bayesian-Occam value of an invariance per model is van der Wilk 2018 / Noether's Razor 2024; and 'value = excluded model space / compression' has been operationalized on real named theories in economics (Fudenberg-Gao-Liang restrictiveness, REStat 2026, and Cueva, 'Theory as data compression', arXiv 2608.25009, 2026), which I confirmed are economics-only; Wu 2026 (invariant-form compression) is conceptual with no computation. The only thing left for E was the empirical measurement on textbook mechanics, and the pilot shows that measurement is not a stable, law-intrinsic quantity, so what remains is at most an incremental negative note. The sweeps' more lenient reading ('weaken, not kill') is defensible for the first clause alone; combined with the pilot results the second clause applies.

summary: Candidate E ("two kinds of compression") should be abandoned. The frozen, pre-registered pilot (24 systems, 9 laws, 512-theory Shapley lattice, 12 codes, 4 machine levels, two semantics) plus two rounds of adversarial verification and three literature sweeps show: K1 fires structurally (the law ranking, and in particular the top law, is set by code, reference machine, decoder charging, constant precision and corpus weighting at the same bit scale as the gaps between laws; top law is EC, UG, N2 or the abbreviation control DIST depending on these choices); K2 is killed in substance (restriction-semantics value is exactly codim x (b + 1/2 log2 2pi), an identity; the only surviving generator-semantics 'constraint' law, energy conservation, has a surplus of exactly -1 bit on every particle system and ~15 n^3 bits on n-link pendulums, is no-value without the family whose ground truth its own decoder generated, and reduces to a repeated Euler-Lagrange map item with a pointer-scale leftover; PC equals an output-referencing macro to 0.0 bits; F=ma has only per-body factoring and (B-1)(S-1)*b Mach-block tying); the literal frozen K2 rule did not fire only because the validity gate was unpassable by construction (POS max 8 bits vs tau 56) and the 7.3 regression was misspecified. K3: the conceptual distinction is standard (Lewis/Woodward, Kitcher, Carnap/Popper, Rissanen, Tahmasebi-Jegelka, Baxter, Fudenberg et al., Cueva 2026), and the residual empirical contribution is shown not to be a stable quantity. Hypothesis (iii) is refuted. Verdict: no_go; stop here.
what_is_actually_new: Nothing that supports the thesis. What is new is a set of worked negative results that turn known theoretical worries into numbers on real textbook laws: (1) in restriction semantics the 'value' of a law is exactly codim x (b + 1/2 log2 2pi) under a Gaussian code (verified in all 18 cells), and 75% of energy conservation's value there is the no-damping slots, so claim (ii) is Carnap's -log pi(H_f) = dimension counting, not corpus content; (2) in generator semantics the top law among {EC, UG, N2, DIST} is determined by the code (12 codes), the reference machine (EC: 3755/788/345/220 bits at D0/D1/D2/D2M), decoder charging, constant precision (N2 linear in B) and single-system corpus membership (P09-P11, G04), i.e. a concrete demonstration that the Kolmogorov invariance constant is the same order as between-law gaps at textbook-corpus scale (Woodward's language-dependence objection to BSA strength, made numerical); (3) explicit macro-equivalences: momentum conservation = output-referencing macro to 0.0 bits; energy conservation = repeated EL residual item with ~13-19-bit leftover per system, exactly -1 bit on every particle system given the force laws and ~15 n^3 on pendulums; F=ma = per-body /m factoring plus 9.33 bits of rank-1 Mach-block tying; (4) the pre-registered classifier for 'constraint vs abbreviation' cannot be validated (positive control unpassable, generic miners recover only 34-78% of a literal macro), which is itself evidence that the corpus-level surplus-above-a-miner is not a well-defined law property. These are confirmations of Lewis/Kitcher/Rissanen/Baxter-style expectations, not a new concept or measure.
strongest_counterargument: The literal frozen decision rule did not fire K2, and K1-primary fired on a 12-bit margin in one code (C2) that three single-system drops cancel; the coarse ordering is stable (LC always last, EC/UG top-3 in most D1 codes, rho >= 0.85 across the primary family); energy conservation survived as constraint-type in every miner setting including D2 and D2M, contrary to the pre-registered prediction; the n^3 count model that removes it was fitted post hoc on only four distinct n values; and the miners are demonstrably weak, so 'collapse' was never fairly tested. A properly converged grammar compressor with binders and variadic templates, AC matching, a canonical fixed machine and a larger, balanced corpus might reveal a genuine residual for variational structure. Rebuttal: the K1-machine kill is robust and by design (top law flips in every code at D2; EC's value is the expansion ratio of its own decoder); the EC residual has already been reduced to pointer scale by hand-written generic macros (family-G leftover ~35 bits < L(EC) = 68.8) and EC is no-value in all four codes once the family whose ground truth is EL(T-V) is removed; the n^3 term is a priori (Christoffel-term count, and equivalently the spec's own r_fk x n) and fits with CV-R^2 >= 0.92 in every code with every particle point exactly -1 bit; every stronger baseline or instrument added so far has moved every label monotonically toward abbreviation, so a better compressor would strengthen the collapse, not reverse it; and choosing a 'canonical fixed machine' is exactly the step K1 shows cannot be made without steering the ranking.
recommended_next_steps: Stop. Do not run a round-2 pilot, extend the corpus, or build a stronger miner; every extension of the baseline so far moved the labels further toward abbreviation, and K1 fires by design.

If any write-up is wanted, keep it to a short negative note (<= 2 pages): (a) the Track R identity I = codim x (b + 1/2 log2 2pi); (b) the K1 table across 12 codes / 4 machines / 5 precisions with the top-law set {EC, UG, N2, DIST}; (c) the macro-equivalences (PC = out-ref macro to 0.0 bits; EC = repeated EL map item; F=ma = per-body factoring + (B-1)(S-1)*b); (d) EC surplus = -1 bit on particles, ~15 n^3 on pendulums. Frame it as a numerical illustration of Woodward's language-dependence objection to BSA strength and of Kolmogorov invariance at corpus scale, citing Lewis, Kitcher, Carnap/Bar-Hillel, Popper, Rissanen/Grunwald, Tahmasebi-Jegelka, Baxter, Fudenberg-Gao-Liang 2026 and Cueva 2026; present claim (ii) as -log pi(H_f), not log #excluded.

Do not pursue the two apparent survivors: codim-0 inequality constraints (POS) are genuinely non-macro but worth ~1 bit per sign-constrained parameter (a trivial count), and variational structure's value is circular (family-G truth generated by EL) and count-degenerate.

If the underlying interest (why F=ma is short yet valuable) is kept, it needs a value definition that is not description length of equations of motion, e.g. out-of-corpus predictive or sample-complexity value under a fixed learner; note that this is already covered in principle by Fudenberg-style completeness/restrictiveness and invariance sample-complexity results, so it is a different candidate that must be re-checked against K3 before any pilot.

Lessons for future pre-registrations from this failure: demonstrate that validity gates are passable on the frozen corpus before freezing; include the a-priori scaling implied by the hazards (here n^3) in count-degeneracy models; require instruments to pass negative controls (recover a known macro >= 90%) before their labels are interpreted; and treat the reference machine as part of the code family for K1 from the start.
